title: Attestations Echo
tagline: Framework to generate attestations based on cross-chain dataset.
description:
Framework to generate attestations based on cross-chain dataset. This project is solving a project to solve replayable attestations framework without having complexity of cross-chains so the trust can grow organically.

Our project also allow to generate attestation without the need of a trusted verifier.
